title: OpenAI finally launches hardware… for Codex
slides: OpenAI's first device isn't what you expected.
Codex runs locally, not in the cloud.
It ships without a keyboard or screen.
Try it: speak your next commit without typing.
thread_text:
1. Not what you expected.

OpenAI's first device runs Codex locally, no cloud needed.

2. No keyboard. No screen.

This device ships without any interface you use to type or read.

3. Voice takes the terminal.

Your command line becomes fully voice-controlled without installing extra software.

4. Talk to your next commit.

You can speak a git commit message and it types it for you.

5. Try it yourself today.

Open a terminal and speak a git command aloud. Does it understand?
video_script: OpenAI's first device isn't a chatbot.
Try speaking your next commit now.

instagram.caption:
OpenAI's first-ever device has no screen and no keyboard — and it’s made for speaking code. 🎙️

Codex now runs entirely on-device, no cloud required. Your terminal becomes voice-controlled without installing anything extra. 💻

You can speak a git commit message aloud, and it types it for you. 

For any developer: your next commit can be fully hands-free. 

When was the last time you typed *anything* by voice that actually worked — and would you trust it for production code?
